text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'll cast my very best spell, just for you!
Every
princess needs a witch, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Magic for a princess! Wait, are you
about to
summon a pumpkin carriage?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, then you just need a nice dress,
and you'll
be set.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My magic isn't for summoning things or
other
mundane tricks like that! It's
reserved for more
noble goals.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Noble... So like turning her into the ideal

princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... a princess with the nobility and
strength to
knock down everything that
stands in my way?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, I do hope to someday obtain the
strength
to tame a wild lion with a stare.
or to hold up a
falling tree with one
finger...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But a true princess has to grow stronger
through
her own efforts! I can't let magic
do all the work!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A w-wild lion?! A falling tree?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to see what kind of training that
entails...
